statement: For the subgroup of Homeo+(R2) generated by the compact image of a based loop, every orbit is open, a point, a Jordan curve, or an intrinsically ordered line admitting a continuous injective parametrization that embeds every compact interval. The restricted loop is compact-open continuous on that intrinsic line, and commuting homeomorphisms induce line homeomorphisms between these orbits. No global subspace embedding or cross-orbit contraction is asserted.
depends_on: Elementary Jordan-curve winding numbers; compact locally connected continua and unique arcs, with branch-point countability proved explicitly; C.12 canonical plane-lift comparison; C.27 for the stated application
manuscript_passages: 23; folios 140–141; scans 279–281; Part C(b) infinite-operator request; exact partial reduction for C.12
depends_on_doubtful_reading: None: the plane loop and orbit hypotheses are independently specified.
notes: The proof exhausts each orbit by compact Peano continua P^n x. Moving a Jordan curve produces an open set by winding-number change; otherwise it is the full orbit. With no Jordan curve the exhaustions are dendrites, and countable branch points plus transitivity eliminate branching and endpoints. Surface gluing and proper-open-orbit contraction remain unresolved, so this does not change C.12's status.
